description: Return the supported countries and their official currencies as an array of `{ code, name, currencies }`. Use to resolve a country name to its ISO alpha-3 code before `get_ppp_factor` or `analyze_ppp`, or to check which countries are covered. Use `list_currencies` for currency codes. Returns the full list in one call and takes no parameters. Public tool: no sign-in and no API request billed.
name: list_countries
title: Country reference
